title: Answer of POST /legacy/link, always 200 for any key: only linked true means the license is now the account's

plan.description: The account's plan after the call

expires_at.description: When the linked license's paid period ends; null when nothing was linked

reason.description: null: linked now. already_linked: this account had it (linked true). not_found: no such key. expired: canceled or past its end. linked_elsewhere: another account or a Team plan holds it. custom_license: converted to a Team plan with us. account_has_license: this account already holds another license
